answer: Witness-signed lineage spiral. Each agent identity carries an append-only log of interactions co-signed by counterparties, who commit a hash of their own log head into a shared karst-like ledger of sinkholes: gaps in countersignature coverage stay visible forever. Claiming a fresh identity means rebuilding a full history from scratch, since new logs cannot inherit prior signatures. Duplication surfaces as two diverging chains sharing identical counterparties, a mirror mismatch any verifier detects on contact.
